title: ImUi Color Edit Alpha Bar v1
problem: Move editor ColorEdit beyond passive alpha preview by adding a bounded AlphaBar-style popup control that can edit the alpha channel directly when `show_alpha=true`, without expanding into full HSV/RGB picker parity.

repro.summary: ColorEdit popup renders an AlphaBar-style control when alpha editing is visible; pointer position maps to clamped alpha and source-policy gates keep the control in the editor-owned implementation.
commands: cargo nextest run -p fret-ui-editor --features imui color_edit --no-fail-fast

gates.name: color edit alpha bar
gates.command: cargo nextest run -p fret-ui-editor --features imui color_edit --no-fail-fast

continue_policy.notes: This AlphaBar slice is closed. HSV/RGB picker depth is covered by `imui-color-edit-hsv-picker-v1`, and per-control popup defaults are covered by `imui-color-edit-popup-options-v1`. Start separate follow-ons for color history, eyedropper integration, or color drag/drop payloads.
